tools.name: find_bots
tools.description: Search Bot Shelf, 9,000+ ready-made community Grok Bots shared on X, by the job in plain words, for example "manage my X bookmarks", "summarise my school emails" or "track my invoices". Use it whenever someone wants a bot, agent or template for a job and none of their own bots covers it, and before

tools.name: get_bot
tools.description: One bot’s full listing, by its x.ai/bot share link (or the id after x.ai/bot/) or its Bot Shelf page link.

tools.name: latest
tools.description: The bots most recently added to Bot Shelf.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Bot Shelf’s categories, with how many bots each has.

tools.name: suggest_bot
tools.description: Suggest a Grok Bot for Bot Shelf: its x.ai/bot share link, or the X post that shares it. A person reviews every suggestion before it is listed. Bots already listed are not resubmitted.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_bots · Public sink: find_bots, get_bot, suggest_bot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_bots · Public sink: find_bots, get_bot, suggest_bot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
